general: EDM-100 is a plastic axial extract fan for 100 mm circular ducts.
Shutters, timers, neon indicators, sensors and window kits depend on the selected suffix; this unqualified record does not specify these options.
H versions use IP40; 12 V versions use IP57/Class III, and Z versions have long-life bearings.
The existing performance curve does not match this catalogue; verify it before using the fan for selection.
motor: Standard 230 V, 50 Hz single-phase motors have class B insulation, overload protection, IP44 and Class II electrical protection.
The documented maximum air temperature is 40 °C; no lower limit is stated.
applications: Local exhaust ventilation in bathrooms, toilets and other small spaces.
